stories.title: Driver caught with no licence and no insurance after erratic driving spotted in North Flintshire
stories.summary: A driver has had their car seized after being caught with no licence and no insurance in North Flintshire. North Wales Police said officers on foot patrol saw the vehicle being driven erratically. A nearby patrol car located the vehicle shortly afterwards. stories.title: North Wales: Cold case review leads to four arrests over Doreen Morris murder
stories.summary: Four people have been arrested in connection with the murder of a woman found dead in her burned-out bungalow on the outskirts of Holyhead more than 30 years ago. stories.title: Flintshire Standards Committee reports ‘growing antagonism’ at council meetings
stories.summary: Flintshire’s standards watchdog says behaviour between councillors has deteriorated over the past year, with growing antagonism inside meetings and online. stories.title: Tarmac seek permission to fix fault line issue after Hendre Quarry land slip
stories.summary: A limestone quarry which sits on a fault line in Flintshire which caused a land slip could be stabilised if owners Tarmac are granted planning permission.
